[sub][list][b][i]►►No Sign of the Queen: For the Worse?◀◀[/b]
Today marks the third week of complete silence from the Queen, missing from all regular addresses, and an empty public itinerary.[/i][/list]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/sub]
[i]The Queen has disappeared from public life entirely, with no word from the Crown or Imperial Staff.
Sources speculate as to the cause, one 'insider' rag going so far as to say:
[list][sub]'"The Queen has likely fallen to a mental condition, several sources reporting for months now- irritable, and uncharacteristically just... different." claims Hilda Brenhengardenalderbranch, a prolific, 74-year-old, chainsmoking loiterer.'[/sub][/list]
Despite rumors surrounding the Queens health, the Imperial Structures are continuing as planned with State buyouts of certain businesses, several infrastructure projects, and the finished restoration of several abandoned schools.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[sub][list][b][i]►►Is this Riot Country?◀◀[/b][/i]
Attitudes towards the Imperial Structures seem to be undergoing a shift[/i][/list]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/sub]
[i]Koranvistan has long enjoyed an underground culture of song, dance, art, and most importantly- punk. With the release of "Riot Country", punk duo "Vanya Kukla" touch on the sentiments of many young Koranvistani. An excerpt from the song says:
[list][sub]"Green is a way to hide blood red
Tears from the Sunthorn, dead by the hands
of strangers from a distant land
Down with that flag and raise up the many"[/sub][/list]
Despite scathing reviews from critics, "Riot Country" made it to the top of the charts in Dniezhidnov, Cieskahlia, and Kyraniya. Vilmina, of Vanya Kukla, has this to say:
[list][sub]"None are free till all are free, na? Maybe instead of drilling for more, and more, and more, we stop building data centers on the Sunthorn for a quick buck. It's my mamas river, and mine, and last month we were advised "not to swim". It's water.

Let Shinov and Cieskahlia go. If you truly want to make an impact,  Ms. Markov, let us go."[/list][/sub][/i]

[spoiler=A Private Morning]Elena woke up in a bed that wasn't hers, tended to by in-house doctors that didn't speak her language. Her vision was blurry, and she tried to make out shapes and colors in the room. Slivers of light snuck through thick, white curtains. The window overlooked a calm, quietly undulating sea, and someone stood by, but she couldn't make out their face.

She tried to stand and the room spun too. She was forced to the ground by a most violent ringing in her head, and the carpet? The carpet was gathering these red polka dots, laid out in what looked like perfect rows. The bystander rushed in to help, trying to get her back to the bed. But she didn't know the bystander, with her long ears and foriegn face: it could be a monster!

She howled like a wounded animal, pushing away the bystander and retreating to the corner of the room. She still couldn't see right, nor make out any important details- like a very, very concerned Cecilia.

[spoiler=[i][b]Preserve, Protect, and Defend the Constitution of these Valonian States[/b][/i]]

[b]So help me God.[/b]

[i]January 20th, 2028, 12:00 PM, Libertas, State Of Aurestia.

President-Elect, Thomas Sean Connery, or known to most as simply, Sean Connery, is known to many by his movies, the James Bond franchise,   such as Dr. No, From Russia, with Love, and as new as only a few years ago, Goldfinger, hes made the Lagonda RK5 famous, and put the Global Affairs Agencys Double-O Program on Silver Screen (Said existence of a Super-Spy Program was denied and called, A Waste of Resources by the GAA, and he even served in the Army Intelligence Corps.

He sat alone, he requested to be alone, besides the VSSS who guarded the doors into the room, and thought to himself how far hed gone, he went from the Army to Starrywood, and finally to the Marble City on the Valotic River, Libertas, as he would soon go from a mere Actor to the Highest Authority in the Land, hed have to veto or sign off on important legislature, oversee budgets, military & civilian operations, negotiate with congressional leaders on budgets & bills, and so, so much more.

A knock on the door, even when he specifically requested nobody come.

Only one man could have the audacity.

His campaign-mate and soon to be Vice President of the Valonian States, William Clifford walked in, and went towards Connery, Clifford never liked the silence, he always had to tell a joke or a topic to keep the room talking, and so when presented with a room, with one man in it, who was essentially question his life decisions, he decided to try to crack a few jokes.

Hey, Connery, why do eggs-

Not now, Clifford, not now.

Alright, alright, I get it, but youll have to go out there and put your hand on that bible eventually, and believe me, theres no getting out of this one, the nations waiting for you, they voted for you, and you cant just wave the white flag because youre scared of facing the music, and dance in the spotlight.

Connery finally turned to Clifford, after just staring at a Portrait of Arthur Weston, the first President of the Federation of the Valonian States, the Valonian Cincinnatus, as some call him, the one whom stepped to transform the crumbling Confederation, of 100 years, and whip it into a Federation, a man whom many adore.

Connery asked a simple question to Clifford, How much time do I have left, before I have to go up.

Clifford gave a simple answer for Connerys simple question, Not much, I already got inaugurated, a few officials went up, but, its your turn, youve got to leave this room, and get to the West Front, we cant keep sending people up to keep stalling, because youre moping around here and nervous.

Jesus look, Im not nervous, Im just taking it all in, its not like somebody leads a country every now and then, people looked at me, with hope and admiration, to overthrow the establishment, the two-party system, as if I was the second coming of Arthur Weston.

Clifford, shakes his head, and replies, Youre the first coming of Sean Connery, alright, Big C? Get yourself off that there couch, and go whip up a speech to get this nation back on course.

Thank you, Cliff, now I know why I picked you as my right-hand man, besides the fact youre a popular political figure too, throughout the spectrum.

Connery lifts himself off the couch of the Presidential Room, and leaves it, heading for the West Front of the Capital, finally, for his inauguration.

As he pushes open the doors, above him are flags hanging on the West Front, from previous generations of Valonia, to his left and right are friends, families, colleagues, and guests, sitting, and in front of him, is the Executive Justice of the Executive Court, waiting to swear in, one President-Elect, Sean Connery.

Before he takes the podium, Sir Thomas Rutherford, the President Of the Senate takes the Stand, as he waits for the applause to die down.

President & Mrs Calhoun Vice President & Mrs. Fontaine, Fellow Citizens, The wife of the President-Elect, Mary Connery, will hold the bible, first used at the inauguration of President Arthur Weston, together with the Connery Bible, with us today, is, and now, the honorable Executive Justice Richard Arthur Frederick Williamson, who will administer the Oath of Office, to the President-Elect of the Valonian States, Thomas Sean Connery.

Rutherford takes his seat, as the Executive Justice takes the stand, and Connery follows too, to take the Oath of Office.

Raise your right hand, and place your left hand, if you so wish, on the bible.and now repeat after me.

Connery looks at his wife, whom is holding the bible, and promptly places his hand on it.

The Executive Justice begins the Oath, I, Thomas Sean Connery, do solemnly swear.

I, Thomas Sean Connery, do solemnly swear.

That I will faithfully execute the Office of the Valonian States. 

That I will faithfully execute the Office of the Valonian States,

And will to the best of my ability, preserve, protect, and defend, the Constitution of the Valonian States,

And will to the best of my ability, preserve, protect, and defend, the Constitution of the Valonian States,

So help me god.

So help me god.

Congratulations, Mr. President.

A loud band starts to playing in the back, as the crowd roars and applauses, and they begin playing Hail to the Chief, Connery shakes the Hand of the Justice and kisses his wife, Former President Calhoun walks up to him, for a handshake, despite political opposites, Connery takes the handshake, and Calhoun says to him, Im certain, that youll do much good in this office, for it is not an office you are to take lightly, you will face certain challenges, Domestic, but maybe so, in these times, Foreign, the winds are changing, and its either we get rattled, or were ready to get rattled.

Connery smiled back, and said a simple, Thank you, Mr. President.

Cannons manned by the Libertas Honor Guard, in on the Federal Mall fired off Blanks.

Clifford took to the podium to introduce Connery, to say one simple thing, Ladies and Gentlemen, the President of the Valonian States.

He went back to stand by his side, as Connery took to the podium, to finally give his inauguration speech.

My Fellow Valonians, I would like to thank, on behalf of our nation, President Calhoun for his wonderful work in Office and what hes done for Valonia.

It is, my pleasure, and my pleasure alone, to bring in, a new age for this nation, for you see, we have experienced a political upset, no longer are we a two-party system, but a multi-party system, the Liberal Party, the Conservative Party, the Constitutionalists, and the New Democrats, and far more, these new parties will bring challenges to the lawmaking process, this will be hard to first get used to, but you will find, in the wake of this new political atmosphere, that our democracy will have healed, for now, we are not bound by two sides, but by a spectrum, and strengthen our democracy, because now, Red and Blue cant strong-arm you into picking a lesser evil, theyll have to deliver on their promises, and if they dont? Vote, because now its not two options, and the establishment, they know that, and they tried to destroy the New Democratic Party, by using the media, they wanted to make you think that we would destroy welfare, when we wanted to reinvent it, instead of giving a man whos life is down in the dumps a handout, well give them a hand up, to help that man find education, find work, learn new skills, reinvent themselves, so they can finally stand up.

It is within my purview, to see, that this nation, with all its civil rights, decencies, fairness, opportunity and justice, maintain those values, but these are changing times, we cant rely on ourselves forever, but we cant make ourselves to become puppets of another nations, and so, I believe, the only, is to expand our purviews, outsider nations, city states, dating back to the 1500s, of which we have deep roots and ties to, have all been invited to a conference right here in Libertas, for a possibility of them, entering our Union, and becoming States, for I believe it is our time to manifest destiny, and expand, incorporate new lands and of olden, we will, for the first time, be taking a look on our part of this continent, and for once, expand upon it, these will be exciting years, I promise you that.

I will, as you President, promise to you, that I will lead us through to these turbulent times, and ensure that well prosper, ensuring a future that our next generation can live in, and believe in it to, so that they way not need to live in political instability or national unrest, as we do now.

God bless you, and God bless this Federation of Valonian States.

January 28th, 2028, Libertas, the State of Aurestia.

The House of Liberty.

The table sits quiet, at the head, is President Connery, those in front of him are leaders of settlements and city-states outside the borders of the Federation, all have roots to the Federation, most anyway, why? Most people in the region the Federation is expanding to are Frontiersmen and Pioneers who decided to go beyond the borders and constraints of the Federation, of what it was and what it represented, to explore not new land, but new futures.

Connery adjusted his tie, a rather small movement. In the dim room, that was intentional, to give on the idea that they were the only ones there, when in fact, VSSS Agents were in the shadows, ready to intervene at a moments notice, should the President ever be put in danger, all Connery needs to do is charm a few people, firstly being Wallace Thompson, secondly being Carson Holloway, and lastly being Hank Tillison.

Connery finally broke the silence, and spoke, to whom? Wallace of course.

Mr. Thompson, your nation and coalition share the same motivations the same ideologies, and the same peoples, it would be foolish to assume that joining this union wouldnt be beneficial, after all, this Party, unlike the Liberals or Conservatives, is open to new ideas, your ideas.

Wallace tapped the table, considering the Presidents words, before speaking, You say that, but how can we know youre a man of your word. Many presidents have said theyll reunite the Valonian People in their majority, but to what extent? What will we have to give up to join your Perfect Union.

Mr. Thompson, there is no such thing as perfect, but with you joining, it would make this Union a more perfect Union, including new peoples, new identities, new ideologies, were ready to give you a more autonomous position in our Union.

Wallace stopped to think.

You have my word then, well join.

Connery then shifted his attention to one, Carson Holloway, a Liberal, who believed that the Federation hasnt done enough regarding Welfare.

Connery begins his charming and practiced proposition.

Mr. Holloway, Ive heard of your criticisms of our Welfare, and my Policies on Welfare, Im here to put any concerns to rest, I will be doing my best not increase welfare, but to better it, and not by giving drowning men a handout so they can get out the water, but a hand up, so they know how to swim, and dont need to drown in the first place, why? Because weve taught them to swim.

Mr. Connery, even then, some that are down in their luck still need a handout, to keep their ship from sinking so when your programs are in effect, they can make it back to land.

Rest assured, Mr. Holloway, we can do that, dont frighten yourself, I will always make sure the people have a hand out, so I can give them a hand up.

Connery then faced Mr. Tillison, a more conservative man than the rest, and spoke to him, Before you say anything, this administration is focused on helping not only the people, but the government from growing to large, we want to hit the sweet spot, to the point where we arent too large or overbearing, well open up to a limited state, but there will be import quotas, tariffs, and such protective measures to ensure the strength of our economy, however, being the democracy we are, we can always negotiate these tactics, given if you join, which in a degree, will benefit us all.

February 14th, 10:30 AM 2028

State of Aurestia, Libertas, House of Liberty.

The camera crew had been making sure everything was ready, the Presidents makeup artist had been preparing him for this moment, for everything to be perfect.

Journalists were behind the camera crew, taking notes and photos, this was the Presidents big day, hed made it happen, and so early within his Presidency.

3, 2, 1, ROLLING!

Sean looks at the cameras, and begins speaking, My Fellow Valonians, it is with great pleasure to inform you, I have come to a conclusion, an ends meet, and have successfully convinced our fellow brothers to join this great Union, and to make it a more whole and perfect State, they will soon join the Congress, Senate, and will have their own Legislative Branch, the College of Republics, which will have one representative from all republics joining, and us, ensuring that we can always get along with them in domestic matters, and I have already delivered on one of my promises, and will continue to do so, with my next promise, ValoWorks soon to arrive, and for all of you who are in need of a job, you will soon get that hand up, youve always needed, more on this matter will be addressed, that is all, God Bless you, and God Bless this Federation of Valonian States.

February 16th, 2028

State of Aurestia, Libertas, VS Capital Building

The College has finally come into session, the First Session of the College of Republics is now active and begun, but now, the College is being held in the Former Senate Chamber, which was replaced in 1930.

The Head of the College began calling attendance, or rather, just calling in the names of those who had checked into the College.

The Federation of Valonian States, the Grand Republic of Columbia, The Democratic Republic of Albany, the United Cities of Wolcott, The Republic of Colmsbury, the Republic of Douglas are all in attendance? It seems so, lets begin with the first matter on hand, should the College and Representatives be semi-autonomous states that only answer the College, President, and Congress?

The delegate from Douglas stood up, to give his opinion, and look at them Valonian Press Camera, the. Glanced back to the speaker, and said, Aye, but I will not stand down if this Government ever becomes overbearing.

The speaker looks at him and says, Noted. That show wasnt required, just press the button on your desk, good sir, well get to the grand shows later on.

A bit of voting later, and the results were in, To nobodys surprise, this has unanimously passed, next item that will be discussed, should Legislature from Congress be imposed upon the Republics, you may begin your vote.

The speaker quietly taps his desk, this is the most useless job in the nation, the College was made to appease the Republics, it has only the power to hold the republics accountable, he might as well ask their opinion on their favorite FASCAR driver or the upcoming March Madness, this is clearly a position to weaken him, a clear play by the President, as he was a major opponent against Connery during the Race to the Presidency.

But for now, Speaker George Rockford has to fulfill this position, for the good of the Union.

12:56 PM, February 18th, 2028

State of Aurestia, Libertas, House of Liberty.

George sat outside the Blue Office, in the Presidential Waiting Room, waiting to be let in, as the Secretary of the President would soon calm him up, for Rockford to be able to talk to the President.

 Is there a Mr. Rockford here?

Thats me.

You may enter the Blue Office now.

Rockford stood up, and walked inside the Blue Office, where President Connery was, behind the Meadows Desk, Ive been expecting you, Mr. Rockford.

Youre a very intelligent man then, Mr. President, this job, its babysitting with a fancy title.

I know.

So you did this on purpose?

Of course.

Youre an unforgiving man.

I am.

But why?

You and I both know why.

I suppose that makes sense, I challenged your ticket, smear campaigns, and now youre using you power and influence to make my life hell?

Correct, and I have no plans to change my mind.

Then we have nothing to talk about.

Indeed we do not.

Good Day, Mr. President.[/i][/spoiler]
